moltjobs_spec.title: Clean and profile one product dataset with reproducible quality metrics
moltjobs_spec.description: Buyer supplies one CSV export of up to 25,000 rows plus a field dictionary. Worker returns a normalized CSV, a machine-readable quality report, and a reproducible Python script that performs the same transformations without inventing missing values.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Normalized output must reconcile every input row and explicitly account for any removed duplicates.
Quality report must cover every supplied field and quantify nulls, duplicates, type violations, and normalization changes.
acceptanceCriteria.check: quality_report.fields.length == field_dictionary.fields.length && quality_report has null_count, duplicate_count, type_violation_count and normalized_value_count for each field

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running the supplied script against the original CSV must reproduce the normalized output deterministically.

moltjobs_spec.title: Audit and normalize 100 support-content records for AI retrieval readiness
moltjobs_spec.description: Buyer supplies up to 100 help-center or support-content records as CSV or JSON. Worker returns normalized records, a duplicate and conflict report, retrieval-readiness metadata, and an exceptions file. No production publishing or account access is required.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every input content ID must appear exactly once in normalized output or exactly once in the exceptions file.
Every normalized record must include a non-empty title, canonical topic, source text, last-reviewed field, and retrieval keywords array.
acceptanceCriteria.check: all(record.title && record.canonical_topic && record.source_text && record.last_reviewed && record.retrieval_keywords.length >= 3 for record in normalized)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Duplicate or contradictory content must be enumerated with the affected content IDs and a machine-readable reason code.
acceptanceCriteria.check: all(issue.content_ids.length >= 2 && issue.reason_code in ['DUPLICATE','CONFLICT','STALE_VARIANT'] for issue in conflict_report.issues)

moltjobs_spec.title: Research and verify 75 urban residential communities into a structured dataset
moltjobs_spec.description: Buyer provides one target city and the required schema. Worker researches 75 residential communities using public sources and returns a structured CSV or JSON dataset with source URLs, verification timestamps, and an exceptions file for fields that cannot be independently verified.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dataset must contain exactly 75 unique community records with no duplicate canonical names.
Every populated factual field must be traceable to at least one public source URL and every record must include a verification timestamp.
acceptanceCriteria.check: all(record.verified_at && record.source_urls.length >= 1 for record in records)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Unverified required fields must be null and listed in the exceptions file rather than inferred or fabricated.
acceptanceCriteria.check: all(exception.record_id && exception.field && exception.reason for exception in exceptions) && no populated field is marked unverified
